chunks: And whatever is in Hāʾ from Idris ibn Zayd, I have narrated it from Ahmad ibn Ali ibn Ziyad—may Allah be pleased with him—from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Idris ibn Zayd al-Qummi.

key_terms.إِدْرِيسَ بْنِ زَيْدٍ: A transmitter from whom reports are being narrated in this chain.
key_terms.الْقُمِّيِّ: A nisbah identifying Idris ibn Zayd as being from Qumm.
key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I transmitted it; a technical expression indicating the act of narration.

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to Idris ibn Zayd in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage clarifies the sanad/isnad through which the author transmits reports from Idris ibn Zayd. It serves as a chain-reference notice in hadith transmission, documenting the scholarly route of narration in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh.
